hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Asia, west of China, south of Kazakhstan || peaks of the Tien Shan mountain range and associated valleys and basins encompass the entire country || landlocked; entirely mountainous, dominated by the Tien Shan range; 94% of the country is 1,000 m above sea level with an average elevation of 2,750 m; many tall peaks, glaciers, and high-altitude lakes || Resources: abundant hydropower; gold, rare earth metals; locally exploitable coal, oil, and natural gas; other deposits of nepheline, mercury, bismuth, lead, and zinc || Exports: gold, coal, precious metal ore, refined petroleum, garments (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: peaks of the Tien Shan mountain range and associated valleys and basins encompass the entire country || Central Asia, west of China, south of Kazakhstan

climate.excerpt: dry continental to polar in high Tien Shan Mountains; subtropical in southwest (Fergana Valley); temperate in northern foothill zone || major flooding during snow melt; prone to earthquakes

economy.excerpt: landlocked, lower-middle-income Central Asian economy; natural resource rich; growing hydroelectricity and tourism; high remittances; corruption limits investment; COVID-19 and political turmoil hurt GDP, limited public revenues, and increased spending || Exports: gold, coal, precious metal ore, refined petroleum, garments (2023) || Industries: small machinery, textiles, food processing, cement, shoes, lumber, refrigerators, furniture, electric motors, gold, rare earth metals
